Title: General availability: Azure Machine Learning user-defined functions in Azure Stream Analytics

Body.Content:
Stream Analytics allows you to easily use an endpoint in your Azure Machine Learning workspace to do real-time scoring and tackle scenarios like anomaly detection and predictive maintenance. Performance tuning options allow you to start small and scale with your input load. The use of rich metrics out of the box allow you to monitor and troubleshooting your streaming jobs with ease. 

To learn more, visit Azure Machine Learning user-defined function in Stream Analytics.
